views.name: tract_basic_demographics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  geo_id,
  total_pop,
  male_pop,
  female_pop,
  median_age,
  white_pop,
  black_pop,
  asian_pop,
  hispanic_pop,
  not_hispanic_pop,
  two_or_more_races_pop,
  households,
  family_households,
  nonfamily_households,
  housing_units,
  vacant_housing_units,
  owner_occupied_housing_units
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
views.description: One-row-per-tract projection of core demographic and household attributes. Use this to quickly filter or join downstream analyses that need population, age, sex, household, and basic housing counts. | Use for: Return demographic attributes for a set of tracts; Filter tracts by population or household counts; Map choropleths of population, race, or household metrics

views.name: tract_housing_rent_buckets_unpivoted
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  geo_id,
  'rent_under_10_percent' AS rent_bucket,

FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
UNION ALL

grain: geo_id, rent_bucket (one row per tract per rent bucket)
views.description: Unpivots the rent burden bucket columns into one row per tract + bucket so analyses can aggregate or rank rent burden categories. Use this when plotting distributions or computing shares across buckets per tract or across tracts. | Use for: Compute share of units in each rent bucket per tract or aggregated area; Plot rent burden distributions across tracts; Rank tracts by share in high rent burden buckets (e.g., rent_over_50_percent)

views.name: tract_income_and_rent_measures
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  geo_id,
  median_income,
  income_per_capita,
  median_rent,
  percent_income_spent_on_rent,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(median_rent, NULLIF(median_income, 0)) AS median_rent_to_median_income_ratio
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
views.description: Per-tract key income and rent measures with derived affordability ratios. Exposes medians and a computed ratio of median_rent to median_income as 'median_rent_to_median_income_ratio' (note: medians are not additive; use this per-tract or when weighting appropriately). Useful for ranking or filtering tracts by affordability. | Use for: Identify tracts with high rent-to-income ratios; Rank tracts by median_income or median_rent; Filter tracts by median_income thresholds or percent income spent on rent

views.name: tract_median_income_rank
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  geo_id,
  median_income,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY median_income DESC NULLS LAST) AS median_income_rank
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
views.description: Ranks tracts by median household income within the entire table and exposes the rank. Use this to implement Top-K median income tracts by downstream filtering on rank. | Use for: Return top N tracts by median_income (filter by median_income_rank <= N); Compare rank vs other measures like median_rent or population
